Name: (AT) More Buildings for Cute Valley Purple for Alternative Textures
Author: BeneathThePlass
Description:
Like many others before me, I'm sure, when I found the [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/content-patcher-cute-valley-1-3-beta.110882/]Cute Valley mod[/url], made by [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/rosalie.518048/]Rosalie [/url]on the Chucklefish forums ([i]now also posted [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3503]here on Nexus[/url][/i]), I loved it instantly. What's not to love, with so much awesomely cute content, in both pink and blue! But, my personal favorite color is purple, so I thought- why not remake this in purple to match! Now, here you have it, a set of Cute Valley- Purple that matches the pink and blue sets I made to match Rosalie's original house and stable!


Included in this mod are the following buildings, done in the blue style of Rosalie's Cute Valley mod;
[i][i]Farmhouse (mailbox & shipping bin included)
Greenhouse
[/i]Alll 7 Guest Cabins
Barn
Big Barn
Deluxe Barn
Coop
Big Coop
Deluxe Coop
[i]Interior for Coop/Barn
[/i]Stable
Fish Pond
Gold Clock
Mill
Shed
Big Shed
Silo
Slime Hutch
[i]Interior for Slime Hutch- you have your choice of the vanilla hutch layout, or a slightly extended hutch layout[/i]
Well
[/i]

This content pack mod is for the awesome[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915] [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url], by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/4112039]PeacefulEnd[/url], so both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] are required for it to work.

If you prefer blue or pink, you can find my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15844][AT] More Buildings for Cute Valley Blue[/url] mod over [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15844]here[/url]﻿, or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15843][AT] More Buildings for Cute Valley Pink[/url] over [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15843]here[/url]!

If you're looking for the content patcher version of this mod, you can find it over [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26093]here[/url]!



[b]Installation: [/b]
1. Make sure that you have both [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] correctly installed in your Stardew Valley folder.
2. Unzip the '[CP] More Buildings for Cute Valley Blue' folder and drop it into your 'Mods' folder in the main SDV game folder.
3. Congrats, you're done and ready to go! Enjoy your new farm!



[b]Credits:[/b]
[list]
[*]Massive credit, of course, to [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/rosalie.518048/]Rosalie [/url]﻿on the Chucklefish forums, as they created the original [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/content-patcher-cute-valley-1-3-beta.110882/]Cute Valley mod[/url]﻿ and provided so much inspiration for these textures!
[/list]
